ludion: PHP 8.4.26 -> 8.4.27 in Dockerfile

Official PHP security releases: 8.4.27.

Ludion receipt 97069e64-e8ba-4abc-bd14-47fc9c687d53: the project's test passed on 0a425b5b7365 and on this change, offline in Docker.
Source Dockerfile only; production was not changed.

LB2b2: form B2 — ci.yml reports a dispatched run's result as the commit status ci/test; php-d and ludion-ci-d.yml

Definitions: Ludion-ai/ludion docs/decisions/2026-10-31-lb2b2-trial-definitions.md, addendum (lane/lb2b2-trial-ci, 6cb0618).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

LB2b2: hourly cron with a check job before Docker; three CI forms (php-a, php-b, php-c) and ci.yml

ludion-php.yml and ludion-npm.yml run hourly (23 * * * *) and start with mode check (ludion-action 6055465), which
ends a run with nothing to do before Docker without reading an earlier run's artifact. ludion-ci-a/b/c.yml (dispatch
only) try the three forms of CI on a Ludion PR: nothing added, workflow_dispatch from the PR job (actions: write), a
commit status (statuses: write). Definitions: Ludion-ai/ludion docs/decisions/2026-10-31-lb2b2-trial-definitions.md
(lane/lb2b2-trial-ci, 1de44a5).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
